title: Danger! Ugnaughts
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: Danger! Ugnaughts at work! That's the title Bob Layton gave this Marvel pin-up (front). Chewbacca is trying to prevent the Cloud City laborers from melting down C-3PO, who has been torn asunder by stormtroopers anxious to keep their presence a secret. On the back, Williamson and Garzon portray the confrontation between good and evil: "No, Luke, I AM your father."
